'''Walking Sheep Heads''' are [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Sheep|Assimilated Sheep]].

==''Spawning''==
*Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Sheep dies.
*Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].

==''Behavior''==
Walking Sheep Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.

*Walking Sheep Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Sheep Heads can perform small leaps.
*They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Sheep.
*Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Sheep Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
*Walking Sheep Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Sheep Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Sheep Heads will run away during the daytime if no other Parasites are present.
